title: fix(plugin-dashboard): KPI tiles drop a title-equal subtitle, fit long figures, centre in the card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQJTzhd1vVrNNMHrh2CgZpe)_

Part of #32165 (item 2, the KPI cards; item 1, one batched dataset query per render, stays open on #32200)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘和大屏上的 KPI 卡片不再把标题再写一遍做副标题（「Avg Progress / 47.0 / Avg Progress」变成「Avg Progress / 47.0」），大屏上的长金额「$1,090,000.00」整串显示不再被截成「$1,090,0…」，数据集指标卡的内容在卡片里垂直居中，不再挤在空荡荡的大卡片顶部。
- 为什么改：QA（#32135）在 showcase 上看到卡片高而空、副标题重复标题、Command Center 的预算被截断，用户读不到完整数字。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` 一个包的渲染，无服务器、spec、元数据改动；网格行高不变，其它组件的卡片不变；短数值保持原字号；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/metricTile.ts`（唯一的副标题规则 `metricTileSubtitle` 与大屏字号阶梯 `METRIC_TILE_BARE_VALUE_LADDER`）、`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/MetricWidget.tsx`（副标题与大屏数值改读它）、`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`（数据集指标卡居中的两行 class）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/metricTileLayout-12623.test.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/metricTileValueScale-12942.test.tsx`，预期 30 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One subtitle rule** (`metricTileSubtitle` in `metricTile.ts`): the first candidate whose localized text is not the localized title, compared after trimming, collapsing spaces and folding case. Read by every tile that draws a subtitle, so there are no per-tile copies:
  - the dataset-bound tile (`DatasetWidget`): caption = description, else measure label, each only if it is not the title. This is where the Chart Gallery's "Avg Progress" came from: the widget title and the dataset measure label are both authored "Avg Progress" (`chart-gallery.dataset.ts` measure `avg_progress`, `chart-gallery.dashboard.ts` widget `kpi_avg_progress`). Delivery Operations' "Total Budget" and Chart Gallery's "Total Spent" had the same repeat. The example metadata is left as it is; the render rule fixes every app.
  - `MetricWidget` (and so `ObjectMetricWidget` / every `object-metric` block): description, else the trend label, both localized (a known trend phrase translated) before the comparison. A description that repeats the label gives way to the trend label.
  - `MetricCard`: its description.
  - The title tooltip (`metricTileTooltip`) no longer stacks the same line twice.
  - A dataset-bound tile with no caption keeps the caption's line empty (`aria-hidden`, `data-testid="dataset-metric-label-spacer"`), so tiles side by side keep their titles and values on one line once they are centred.
- **The truncation was the `bare` face, not the card tile.** Command Center's six-across hero strip draws `object-metric` with `variant: 'bare'`, whose value was a fixed `text-[2rem] truncate`; the card tiles already had the objectui#12942 ladder. Measured at 1440×900: each hero tile is 166 px wide, `$1,090,000.00` is 7.36 em by `metricTileValueEm`, 235 px at 32 px. The bare value now reads `METRIC_TILE_BARE_VALUE_LADDER` against the tile's own box (`@container` on the bare root): short values keep `text-[2rem]` at every width; a longer value climbs 14 → 16 → 18 → 20 → 24 → 30 → 32 px, each step at `ceil(maxEm × px)`. The budget draws at 20 px, whole (`scrollWidth == clientWidth`), with the full figure as its tooltip. The line box is a fixed 32 px (`leading-8`, placed after the size classes because `cn` drops a line-height written before a font size), so the label under a scaled value lines up with its neighbours'.
- **The height.** A dataset-bound metric card spans two `minmax(5rem, auto)` grid rows: 176 px measured, while the tile's content is 90 px and sat at the top of the card. The card is now a column (`flex flex-col`) and its body fills it (`flex-1`), so the tile's existing `justify-center` centres it. Grid rows are unchanged; every other widget's card is untouched (pinned as a CONTROL).
- **Root changeset** `.changeset/32165-metric-tile-subtitle-fit.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` patch, with the two declaration lines.

`Clause-②: no` measured: `metricTile.ts` is not re-exported from the package entry (`index.tsx` names none of it), and no published prop or type changes.

## Tests

- `metricTileLayout-12623.test.tsx` (the tile layout harness), new top-level describes:
  - *a subtitle equal to the title is not drawn (objectstack#32165)*: dataset tile with measure label = title draws no caption, keeps the spacer, tooltip names it once; equal up to case and spacing; description = title gives way to a distinct measure label; CONTROL distinct measure label kept; `MetricWidget` description = label hidden; localized (zh-CN) comparison; trend label kept and takes the place of a repeated description; CONTROL distinct description kept; `MetricCard` hidden + CONTROL; `object-metric` hidden.
  - *a dataset-bound metric tile is centred in its card*: card `flex flex-col`, body `flex-1`; CONTROL a table card is not a column.
- `metricTileValueScale-12942.test.tsx` (the value ladder harness), new describe *the bare tile's value ladder*: every step re-derived from `ceil(maxEm × px)`; CONTROL a short value keeps 32 px and no tooltip; the exact Command Center value `$1,090,000.00` at the measured 166 px draws at 20 px and fits (and did not at 32 px), tooltip carries it, `leading-8`.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored with blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. `metricTile.ts`: `if (title && metricTileSameText(title, candidate)) continue;` → `if (false /* ablated-32165 */) continue;` (the old subtitle choice): 8 failed / 3 passed in the subtitle describe (every hide pin red, the three CONTROLs green).
2. `MetricWidget.tsx`: the bare value's `metricTileValueClass(displayValue, METRIC_TILE_BARE_VALUE_LADDER)` → `'text-[2rem] truncate tabular-nums'` (the old face): the Command Center budget pin red, 2 passed.
3. `DashboardRenderer.tsx`: `datasetMetric && "flex flex-col",` → `false`: the centring pin red.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- QA's three readings are gone on a fresh showcase boot from this branch's source (shots below): no title-equal subtitle on Delivery Operations / Chart Gallery, Command Center's budget whole, KPI content centred in its card.
- Delivery Operations' `$1,090,000.00` (dataset tile, 238 px) was never truncated: it fits at 24 px before and after.
- **Finding, per-widget duplicate query (not fixed, item 1 is #32200's):** on the dev boot every dataset widget posts its `/analytics/dataset/query` twice (Delivery Operations 9 dataset widgets → 18 posts; Chart Gallery and System Overview the same pattern, identical bodies). The Console mounts under `<StrictMode>` (`ui/apps/console/src/main.tsx`), which runs each mount effect twice in development, so this is most likely the dev double-effect, not a production double fetch; a production build was not measured here. No batching layer, queue or cache was added.
- **System Overview skeletons (read only):** on a full page load of `/apps/setup/dashboard/system_overview` (dev Vite, warm server) the skeletons cleared at 7.1 s. The wait is the app shell, not this widget: the dev module graph took ~5.1 s before the first app request, then shell reads (`auth/me/permissions`, `meta/app`, `meta/app/setup/bundle`, `sys_user_preference`) to ~5.6 s, `meta/dashboard` + `meta/view` to ~5.65 s, `/packages` to ~6.23 s; the 14 dataset queries (7 widgets ×2) started at 6.09 s and all answered by 6.36 s (150–270 ms each); the remaining ~0.7 s is chart chunk load and paint. Nothing inside the metric widget holds the skeleton, so no fix here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Browser: showcase dev boot from this branch (main 8523ef9a + this diff), Console Vite over branch source, 1440×900, shots in the project folder ui-orders/32165-shots/</summary>

- `before-*.png` taken with the four touched files restored to `main` (served-code marker count 0), `after-*.png` with the branch (marker count 3), Vite restarted with `--force` per leg.
- Chart Gallery: before "Avg Progress / 47.0 / Avg Progress", "Total Spent / $616,000.00 / Total Spent"; after "Avg Progress / 47.0", "Total Spent / $616,000.00", "Total Tasks / 10 / Tasks" (distinct caption kept). Tile box 90 px → 142 px inside the 176 px card, content centred.
- Delivery Operations: "Total Budget / $1,090,000.00 / Total Budget" → "Total Budget / $1,090,000.00"; "Active Projects / 2 / Projects" kept.
- Command Center: budget at 32 px "$1,090,0…" → 20 px "$1,090,000.00", `scrollWidth == clientWidth` 166, title attribute the full figure; the five short values stay 32 px; every hero tile 52 px tall with a 32 px value line.

</details>

At head `f7442bf1` (merge base `8523ef9a`):

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard test` → 203 files, 1975 passed, 6 skipped; `type-check` exit 0 (under `os-verify-lock`).
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` 0; ADR-0060 ratchet (`product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`) 34 passed; `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` 0.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-dashboard --filter=@object-ui/console` 0, then `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` 0 (2214.0 KB gzipped of a 2431.6 KB budget).
- `npx eslint` on the seven touched files: 0 errors (18 pre-existing warnings, none on a changed line); `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 36 derived, 36 run, all exit 0; `--ran`: 36 accounted, 0 NOT-MEASURED, exit 0. Extra: `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` 0 (its roster sits under `.changeset/`).
